question: What restaurant can I find within 150 kilometers when heading from Manatee Viewing Center, Apollo Beach, FL toward Freedom Lake Park, Pinellas Park, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.400924 27.792747)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.698397 27.861949)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.400924 27.792747)',4326)::geography, 150000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.400924 27.792747)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
